text:
sara.ops: FYI canary in eu-central hung during post-upgrade hook. Deploy-bot put the promotion on hold: `deploy-bot: hold - postupgrade hook failed (hook: ensure-configmap)`

max.eng: I pulled the hook logs, looks like `Error: configmaps \"auth-config\" already exists` during create. Chart v3.0.0 removed release-scoped prefix so name collides across overlays.

nina-sre: that explains the staging hit earlier today. Did the chart change note mention dropping release prefix? I missed that in the changelog.

max.eng: changelog said \"simplify names\". Oops. It assumed namespaces isolate us. For multi-tenant overlays we have identical names in same namespace.

jamal-pm: Impact? customer-facing? change window?

sara.ops: only internal infra services impacted so far, but promotion stuck for 4 regions (eu-central, eu-west, ap-south, us-west). EU change window ends in 40m.

tony-eng: Options: 1) pin the chart back to v2.9.5 and re-promote (fast), 2) perform an emergency deploy plan override to set `auth.configMapName: auth-config-{{ release.namespace }}` for blocked groups (no chart publish), 3) hotfix chart and publish v3.0.1 then re-run full pipeline (~1hr).

nina-sre: I prefer option 2 if we can apply overrides per-release quickly. It avoids rollbacks and DB ops.

jamal-pm: timeline favors 2 as well. We should document it in release notes as a temporary override and schedule proper chart fix.

max.eng: I can craft the override values YAML and apply to the affected release groups. Example snippet:
```yaml
auth:
  configMapName: auth-config-{{ .Release.Namespace }}
```
This will be rendered by Helm templating at deploy time using the release namespace.

sara.ops: @max.eng go ahead. I'll set the deploy-bot override for groups: eu-central, eu-west, ap-south, us-west and re-trigger promote.

deploy-bot: applying per-release values override for: `service/auth@2026-03-21-973`

deploy-bot: promotion paused -> override applied -> re-queuing groups (eu-central, eu-west, ap-south, us-west)

max.eng: Canary re-ran in eu-central, postupgrade hook succeeded. Can confirm configmap created with namespace suffix. :white_check_mark:

jamal-pm: Release notes blurb: \"Temporary per-release values were applied to avoid configmap name collisions introduced in auth chart v3.0.0. A proper chart patch v3.0.1 will follow to reintroduce stable release-scoped names and CI preflight checks.\"

nina-sre: Follow-ups: 1) PR to chart to restore release-scoped naming (v3.0.1), 2) add preflight to catch static resource names, 3) update changelog template to highlight name-breaking changes.

tony-eng: I'll add a lint rule that warns when templates produce non-namespaced-unique resource names.

sara.ops: I'll keep the overrides in place for these groups until v3.0.1 is promoted. Filing tasks and adding to ops runbook.

deploy-bot: promotion complete -> groups promoted successfully (eu-central, eu-west, ap-south, us-west)

sara.ops: closing thread 91 follow-ups captured. Thanks everyone :)
